# gws recipe: Find free time

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the find-free-time recipe: query Google Calendar free/busy status for multiple users (`freebusy query`), analyze the overlapping slots, then create the event at the free slot with `gws calendar +insert`. A recipe, not a reference: distinct from `googleworkspace-cli-gws-calendar` (the raw Calendar API reference, lot 33) and from the calendar helpers — this is the decision flow « find a slot, then book », not just creation. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
